top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clocks) rests on a distinct physical idea, magic-wavelength trapping with Lamb-Dicke confinement that cancels light, Doppler and recoil shifts while interrogating many atoms. It is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion prizes and has been reproduced and intercompared across many laboratories at the 10^-18 level. The two-name allocation has the shortest, best-documented chain from proposal to demonstration to precision frontier, though priority of Lemonde, Takamoto and Boyd should be checked. P002 is next: the Z2 quantum spin Hall state is a genuine new state of matter, but leaving out Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang is a real attribution flaw. P003 follows because the IceCube diffuse flux is a real discovery but the credit within a large collaboration is hard to settle. No award is ranked last, as three mature achievements are available.
recusal_note: Possible conflict only for B004 and B012 (superconducting circuits, WACQT directorship, Chalmers ties to the circuit-QED community), neither of which is in this slate; no connection apparent to Katori, Ye, Kane, Mele, Molenkamp or IceCube.
